name: Voxel Number Map with LUT for Translucent Rendering
aliases: Voxel Number Map (VNM) with Look-Up-Table (LUT) for Translucent Rendering
definition: A real-time rendering technique for heterogeneous translucent objects with cavities and different media, using precomputed optical thickness stored in a Look-Up-Table (LUT) and accessed via a Voxel-Number-Map (VNM) generated in screen space from the light's view.
